title: Append
summary: APPEND', verb transitive [Latin appendo, of ad and pendeo, to hand.] 1. To hang or attach to, as by a string, so that the thing is suspended; as, a seal appended to a record. 2. To add, as an accessor

inlines.v: APPEND', verb transitive [Latin appendo, of ad and pendeo, to hand.] 1. To hang or attach to, as by a string, so that the thing is suspended; as, a seal appended to a record. 2. To add, as an accessory to the principal thing.
